components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action, yellow with asphalt text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.0625rem; padding: 1rem 1.9rem; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFD200; color: #424242; transition: background .2s, translate .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffe04a; translate: 0 -2px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(255,210,0,.55); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Text Link Button
components.description: Secondary action: white text with a thick yellow underline.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.0625rem; padding: 1rem .25rem; color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #FFD200; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-btn-text:hover { text-decoration-color: #fff; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Bli fadder Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: .65rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #FFD200; color: #424242; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #424242, 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5); transition: background .2s; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #ffe04a; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Spine Nodes
components.description: Lamp-post navigation: grey pole, dot per section, yellow when lit, tooltip label on hover.
components.css: .ds-spine { position: relative; width: 88px; height: 200px; background: #2f2f2f; display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: space-around; } .ds-pole { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 4px; translate: -50% 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #7a7a7a; } .ds-node { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-node span { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8d8d8d; transition: background .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), scale .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-node span.is-lit { background: #FFD200; } .ds-node:hover span, .ds-node:focus-visible span { scale: 1.5; } .ds-node::after { content: attr(data-label); position: absolute; left: calc(100% + 10px); top: 50%; translate: -6px -50%; padding: .3rem .7rem; border-radius: 6px; white-space: nowrap; background: #fff; color: #424242; font: 600 .875rem 'Open Sans', sans-serif; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .25s, translate .25s; } .ds-node:hover::after, .ds-node:focus-visible::after { opacity: 1; translate: 0 -50%; } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Flame List
components.description: Light-weight list items with the shared flame as bullet and hairline dividers.
components.css: .ds-needs { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #424242; color: #fff; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-needs li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; padding-block: 1.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #5e5e5e; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-needs li:first-child { border-top: 1px solid #5e5e5e; } .ds-needs svg { flex: none; width: 22px; aspect-ratio: 164 / 223; color: #FFD200; }

components.description: Dashed marker for every fact not yet supplied.

narrative.overview:
The page is a street after dark. A darker lamp-post gutter runs down the left edge as the spine; a flame-headed lamp travels it as the visitor scrolls, and each section is lit in turn by a soft pool of yellow on asphalt. Dark asphalt stands for the hardship the work answers; yellow is the light of hope, spent deliberately. Two sections are fully drenched in yellow, so the page alternates between night and lit street.

Density is calm and editorial: one wide column family, generous vertical bands, Light-weight headlines, no cards. Structure is drawn with hairlines, dashed rules and dots, not boxes. Depth comes from light, never from elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Asphalt ground, one fixed darker spine, white text, yellow as light.
Open Sans Light for headlines, Semibold and Bold for emphasis.
Flame symbol (SVG, one shared symbol) is the only icon and the only bullet.
Glow and radial pools instead of shadows or cards.
Dashed asphalt-line rules for connection and unfinished things.
Motion is light: slow lamp travel, a gentle flicker, lamps lighting in sequence.

rules.name: The Light Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Yellow means light or the next action. On asphalt it appears as small glows, flames, one button and a pill; large yellow fields are limited to the two light bands.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green belongs to the Ethiopian side of the organisation story and to nothing else.

rules.name: The Asphalt-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Text on yellow is always Asphalt, never white; the focus ring flips from white to Asphalt there.

rules.name: The Light-Weight Voice Rule
rules.body: Big type is Light (300). Weight rises as size falls.

rules.name: The Caps Are Headings Only Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with tracking appears on H3 titles and definition terms, which are real headings or terms, not decorative labels.

rules.name: The Glow, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Yellow things emit light outward in yellow; nothing casts a hard or offset shadow.

dos: Do let light be the only emphasis: yellow glows, flames and a single primary action per view.
Do keep Light (300) for large type and step to 600 or 700 as size falls.
Do draw structure with 1px solid or 2px to 3px dashed lines in Asphalt Line (#5e5e5e); on yellow bands use Asphalt.
Do use the one shared flame symbol for every icon and bullet.
Do mark every missing fact with the dashed placeholder tag.
Do keep text on yellow in Asphalt (#424242) and flip the focus ring to Asphalt there.
Do disable motion under prefers-reduced-motion (all animation and transitions are already switched off).
donts: Don't use cards, boxed tiles or hard offset shadows; the world is open bands and light.
Don't use green anywhere except the Etiopien organisation.
Don't use photography of children as decoration or invented numbers, quotes or payment details.
Don't treat the Nunito wordmark as a brand face or reuse it in headings.
Don't use the red accent from the brand guide until a surface calls for it; the build uses none.
